defects.defect: The planned FlowTest asserts that the Get Records queue lookup returns a record and depends on a per-org placeholder Storefront__c ID (TEST_STOREFRONT_ID). It does not assert the behavior that matters, which is that a Case is created with the right owner, links, and subject. An after-save FlowTest cannot observe a related-record Create, so the row adds little coverage.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: spec-format does not say what a FlowTest can assert for an after-save flow whose only effect is creating a related record.

defects.defect: Section 6 says '80 permission sets and profiles already grant Read on Case (partial list; not all rows name their parent)'. That count is vague and cannot be acted on.
